logline: You are the 13th Demon Lord. Resurrected 50 years after a stalemate with the Hero, you seek your rematch. First, you must rebuild your Kingdom, defeat the Ten Stars of the Adventurer Guild, and ally with your sworn enemy to stop the Inverse World.

characters.name: The Maou
characters.description: Used a 'Pact with the World' 50 years ago to ensure a rematch with the Hero.

characters.name: Ignis
characters.description: Betrayed by the Church 50 years ago. Loyal defender of the tomb.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: Unsealed early on. Provides soul-siphoning magic.

characters.name: The True Hero (MC)
characters.description: The Hero from 50 years ago. Forced to ally with the Maou in Arc 4.

characters.name: The Mercenary King
characters.description: Warlord leader of the Guild fodder.

characters.name: The Sword Saint
characters.description: Blind swordsman capable of one-shotting units.
